name: emotions
character: What each feeling asks for, as facts a small model can choose and a gate can check: the order of the cues, what it forbids, and the measurements that would show it was not delivered. The numbers stay in scripts/compose.py EMOTIONS; this file says what the numbers MEAN, and every entry must name a mood compose already knows.
why_this_order: Listener studies put mode first, then tempo, then register, dynamics, articulation and timbre, and find the cues roughly additive (references/scoring/emotion-and-scoring.md section 1). Choosing them in this order is what stops one cue contradicting the rest.

calm.character: nothing is at stake; the music holds still and lets the room be heard

grief.character: loss that has already happened; nothing is being fought

sad.character: falling lines and long rests; the piece loses something as it goes

tender.character: close and unguarded; quiet enough that a breath is audible

hopeful.character: it is not resolved yet, but it is going to be

epic.character: the frame is bigger than the person in it

dark_epic.character: the same size, aimed at you; power without triumph

tense.character: pressure that does not release; the ear waits for a resolution that does not come

scary.character: something is wrong and it is not going to explain itself

mysterious.character: a question, held open; the harmony never settles on an answer

wonder.character: the scale of it lands before anything else does

focused.character: it stays out of the way on purpose; no event, no peak

joyful.character: nothing is being withheld; the line rises and the rhythm agrees with it

playful.character: light on its feet, and allowed to be a little wrong on purpose

determined.character: one idea, repeated forward; the harmony does not wander

energetic.character: the tempo is the point; every layer agrees on the pulse

angry.character: weight pushed at the listener; the low end is the argument

adventure.character: moving through somewhere new; the material keeps opening

triumphant.character: the arrival is earned; brass and low end carry it

majestic.character: vast and unhurried; the piece has more space than notes

dreamy.character: edges softened; the harmony drifts without landing

melancholy.character: sadness with some light left in it; a major third appears and is taken away

nostalgic.character: warm and slightly out of reach, as though heard through something

passionate.character: the line pushed to the top of its range and held there

provenance.order: the cue order of emotion-and-scoring.md section 1, which the document takes from listener studies
provenance.emotions.*.density: starting value: the layer count a mood usually carries, from the arc table in section 2
provenance.emotions.*.qa.max_onsets_per_s: starting value, uncalibrated until the first measured renders
provenance.emotions.*.qa.crest_floor_db: starting value: a piece with less crest than this has been held still
provenance.emotions.*.register: the register column of the same table
